capabilities: Run JavaScript from js-engine code blocks in notes
Render returned values as Markdown or plain text in place
Debug code blocks with rerun and stats via js-engine blocks
Import JavaScript files from the vault
Expose a plugin API for other plugins to execute code
extras: API docs and a TypeScript API helper package are hosted outside the README; each release bundles an obsidian-js-engine-api.tgz tarball for cross-plugin integration.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to execute JavaScript within notes and display computed or generated results inline.
summary: Code-block-based JavaScript runner that executes scripts inside notes and renders their output in place.
